map.最关键的是「同一密钥流绝对不能重用」：流密码把明文与密钥流逐位异或，若两组明文用: The key point is that a keystream must never be reused: a stream cipher XORs the plaintext with the keystream bit by bit, so if two plaintexts used the same keystream (same key plus IV or nonce), XORing them cancels the key and directly yields the XOR of the two plaintexts. So every encryption must use a unique nonce; and a stream cipher offers no integrity protection on its own, so pair it with a MAC or use an AEAD.
